sources.details: A single hello pretoken has four initial letters h,e,l,o and four merges to reach hello (5 positions because l repeats); with [UNK] the resulting vocab has 9 items, below requested cap 20. Whole hello is one ID; independently encoding two nonempty known-letter strings hel/lo gives at least two IDs. 貓 is 3 UTF8 bytes, 🙂 is 4, hello hello is 11 ASCII bytes: 18 bytes total. Whitespace drops the separating blank; two complete hello pretokens yield [8,8]. No ratio, tensor axis or model quality metric is claimed in 6.9.
